tells: 1. The laugh barely happens: across six frames only the woman in white lifts a hand to her mouth and the green-hoodie man turns his head; nobody's shoulders heave, no mouths open wide, no torsos rock back, so it reads as people noticing something rather than a laugh building (club-5-strip.png, front table row, all frames)

2. The back of the room is a wall of identical flat black standing cut-outs with no motion, no seats and no tables, so the house looks like a painted backdrop behind a few living front tables (club-1-wide.png and club-2-mid.png, upper middle band behind the front tables)

3. Front-row hands repeat the same rest pose: both hands flat or cupped on the table edge or around the candle for nearly everyone, and the green-hoodie man's clasped hands sit right over the lit candle (club-3-mid.png, centre table; club-1-wide.png, front tables)

4. The face close is a game-character face: waxy uniform skin, eyes with no wet highlight focused off at nothing, a half-open mouth that is neither talking nor laughing, plus a dark outline halo along the white collar and shoulder against the blurred background (club-4-face.png, centre face and the right shoulder edge)

5. Rigid upright torsos: the mid shots have most of the front row sitting with the same straight spine and level shoulders, and the pink-jacket man's forearm presses into his neighbour with no contact deformation (club-3-mid.png, left half; club-6-held.png, left edge)

1. The rows behind the front two read as standing mannequins: straight, symmetrical bodies with arms hanging at their sides, stacked like a choir riser rather than people slumped in raked seats, and the left block hangs over a black void (theatre-1-wide.png, rows 3 and back plus the left third)

2. The laugh reads as pain or nausea: heads drop forward, mouths open on a black empty interior with no teeth or tongue, eyes cast down; the bun-blonde and the dark-jacket man on the right fold over as if coughing (theatre-4-face.png, mouth; theatre-2-mid.png, centre and right of the front row)

3. Front-row poses are copies: almost everyone sits upright on the seat edge with both hands on the knees or clasped between the thighs and legs hanging forward, so the row looks posed for a class photo (theatre-1-wide.png and theatre-6-held.png, front row)

4. The onset is too uniform: between 12.4 and 12.8 five front-row people open their mouths and dip their heads in the same window while the second row does nothing at all, so it reads as a trigger rather than a laugh spreading (theatre-5-strip.png, frames 12.4-12.8, front vs second row)

5. Skin and hair break down: the second-row heads have flat, overlit, low-detail faces that look like masks, the dark-jacket man's hair is a garbled cap texture, and the people on the left edge glow pink, as if they were translucent (theatre-3-mid.png, right edge head and left group; theatre-2-mid.png, second row)

1. Hands-on-knees forward lean everywhere: almost the whole front row sits with both hands on the knees and shoulders hunched forward in the same pose, which reads as a sprinter's crouch or a waiting room, not a relaxed audience (openmic-1-wide.png and openmic-6-held.png, front row)

2. The laugh is social but shallow: the green-top woman and the dark-hoodie woman turn to each other with open mouths and the afro man grins, but bodies don't heave or rock and the people on the edges stay still, so it peaks at chatter rather than a laugh (openmic-5-strip.png, frames 12.6-13.0, centre)

3. Face defects at mid distance: the red-jacket man in the second row has a dark smear over his nose and mouth, and the dark-hoodie woman's head hangs forward with her face lost (openmic-3-mid.png, second row centre and front centre)

4. The face close is dead behind the eyes: a smooth plastic forehead, irises with no catchlight, and a fixed, slightly sly mouth; the hair edge has a dark jagged fringe halo against the blurred background, and a ghosted blurred hand floats at the right (openmic-4-face.png, hair line upper right and lower right background)

5. Flat, murky light with poor depth separation: the crowd is a single brown-orange mass with no rim separating the rows, the back wall's downlights are evenly spaced decorative dots, and the wide's composition puts empty black over the top third (openmic-1-wide.png, whole frame; openmic-6-held.png, back rows)
